segments.text: Somewhere under inhere is one file: a regular file, exactly one thousand and thirty-three bytes, and not executable.
I log in as bandit5 with ssh bandit5@bandit.labs.overthewire.org -p 2220.
Find can express all three conditions in one pass, so I run find inhere, type f, size 1033 c, not executable.
Exactly one path survives: inhere slash maybehere zero seven slash dot file two.
It prints the password for bandit six, and the level is solved.
